metastatic non‑small cell lung cancer (adenocarcinoma, KRAS‑mutated)

candidates.description: Presence of the KRAS G12C (p.G12C/c.34G>T) mutation in the tumor.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search genomic findings tables or pathology summaries for 'KRAS', 'G12C', 'p.G12C', or 'c.34G>T'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if the genomic report explicitly identifies the KRAS G12C (p.G12C or c.34G>T) mutation; Negative if the report explicitly states the KRAS gene is wild-type or no mutation was detected. Absence of a genomic report does not constitute a negative measurement.
candidates.name: KRAS G12C Mutation Status
candidates.uncertainty: Whether 'KRAS-mutated' in general clinical notes always refers specifically to G12C without genomic confirmation.

candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value associated with 'pack-year history' or 'pack-year history' from the social history section.
candidates.measurement_definition: Numeric value of pack-years (calculated as packs smoked per day multiplied by years of smoking).

candidates.uncertainty: Precision of the reported values (e.g., approximate symbols like '≈' used in some records).

limitations: The sample size of provided excerpts is small, limiting the diversity of genomic profiles available for discovery.

summary: The provided evidence identifies several baseline clinical characteristics in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), most notably specific genomic drivers (KRAS G12C), cumulative tobacco exposure (pack-years), and functional status (ECOG).
